verdict.rationale: A hands-on user reports that their favorite Warp feature is a notification when a long-running command finishes. Another user notes that output is chunked into per-command Blocks, which shows command-aware shell integration. However, no first-party docs in the pack describe these terminal features, and the exit-status and duration parts of the story are not evidenced at all. The documented 'notifications' refer to third-party CLI agents, not shell commands, so they are not credited. missing for 10: evidence of per-command exit status display, evidence of command duration tracking, first-party documentation of long-command completion notifications.
